exposure: Birth of a low birthweight infant requiring NICU admission
cohort: Four groups of women after childbirth: those who gave birth to LBW infants requiring NICU admission, those who underwent EmCB, those who had VB, and those who had PCB.
finding: The study aimed to compare PTSD symptoms and maternal interactive behavior in women after childbirth based on their birth experience (at-risk vs. low-risk).
birth_weight: Low birth weight mentioned for one group
